description: This file defines a static utility enum 'KeychainStore' that provides methods to load, save, and delete string values in a keychain, by delegating to 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore'.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string from the keychain given a service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string to the keychain with specified service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a keychain item for the specified service and account.
